evidencePolicy.externalSourceRequirement: Grammar and register conclusions require independently checkable linguistic analysis.
evidencePolicy.corpusRule: Attestation does not establish unrestricted productivity, preferred analysis, register, or dialect-wide naturalness.

sources.citation: Glossika Cantonese (HK) A1, Week 14, Cantonese – Making Plans & Appointments, 2026-06-21
sources.scope: Exact lesson forms, source Jyutping, source glosses, source order, and pedagogical labels only.

sources.citation: Li Lee, May-yu. 1983. Making Apologies in Cantonese.
sources.scope: Cantonese apology choice varies with situational and social variables including role, age, severity, and interlocutor background.

sources.citation: Lee, Cynthia. 2008. The Cantonese apology style for personal offences in native and second languages in electronic communication. Journal of Intercultural Communication 8(3):1–16.
sources.scope: Cantonese apology strategies are multi-componential and sensitive to offence interpretation and communicative situation.

sources.citation: Wong, Jock, and Congyi Liu. 2019. Two Ways of Saying ‘Thank You’ in Hong Kong Cantonese: m-goi vs. do-ze. In Further Advances in Pragmatics and Philosophy, Part 2, 435–447.
sources.scope: 唔該 and 多謝 have distinguishable meanings and functions; they are not merely formality variants, although some contexts permit both.

sources.citation: Lee, Mei-shan. 2013. Gratitude expressions with mh-goi and do-jeh in Cantonese: their syntax, lexical semantics and sentence semantics. University of Hong Kong thesis.
sources.scope: Direct analysis of the two principal Cantonese gratitude expressions and their syntax and semantics.

sources.citation: Sybesma, Rint, and Boya Li. 2007. The dissection and structural mapping of Cantonese sentence final particles. Lingua 117(10):1739–1783.
sources.scope: Direct structural and semantic analysis of Cantonese sentence-final particles, including g-initial and tone-3 particle families.

sources.citation: Yu, Zhiyin, and Xiaoshi Hu. 2025. The Syntax of the Sentence-final Particle gaa3 in Cantonese. Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 104(2):653–678.
sources.scope: 㗎 gaa3 occurs in declarative, interrogative, and exclamative structures across multiple discourse contexts; a single coarse gloss is inadequate.

sources.citation: Wong, Anita M.-Y., Cheung, C. C.-H., Lo, J. M.-W., and Wan, E. K.-H. 2022. Grammatical Analysis of Cantonese Samples. In Understanding Development and Disorder in Cantonese Using Language Sample Analysis.
sources.scope: 幾 gei2 is analyzed as a degree adverb meaning approximately ‘quite’, modifying an adjective or stative verb.

sources.citation: Lam, Charles, Chaak-ming Lau, and Jackson L. Lee. 2024. Multi-Tiered Cantonese Word Segmentation. LREC-COLING 2024:11993–12002.
sources.scope: Cantonese numerals are compositionally structured even when a word-level segmentation tier treats the written numeral as one unit; numeral-classifier structure remains independently productive.

sources.citation: Bauer, Robert S., and Paul K. Benedict. 1997. Modern Cantonese Phonology.
sources.scope: Reference inventory and analysis of Cantonese vowels, syllables, and phonological contrasts.

sources.citation: Luo, Jingxin, Vivian Guo Li, and Peggy Pik Ki Mok. 2020. The Perception of Cantonese Vowel Length Contrast by Mandarin Speakers. Language and Speech 63(3):635–659.
sources.scope: Perception of /aː/–/ɐ/, /ɛː/–/e/, and /ɔː/–/o/ involves exposure and both quality and duration; the contrasts should not all be taught as duration-only.

claims.claim: The lesson's binary Casual/Polite labels are not an adequate linguistic classification of the apology forms.
claims.boundary: Retain the labels as immutable source metadata only; do not convert them into runtime register features.

claims.claim: 唔好意思 and 對唔住 cannot be ordered by a simple casual-versus-polite scale without specifying offence, discourse purpose, severity, and interlocutor relation.
claims.boundary: The sources support contextual sensitivity, not a complete item-by-item semantic decomposition of the two lesson forms.

claims.claim: 唔該 and 多謝 are functionally and semantically distinct gratitude expressions rather than casual and polite versions of one expression.
claims.boundary: Some contexts permit overlap; do not encode a categorical one-context-only rule from this packet.

claims.claim: Sentence-final 㗎 gaa3 is compatible with declarative, interrogative, and exclamative structures and has context-sensitive discourse interpretations.
claims.boundary: The lesson's generic SFP gloss does not determine which gaa3 analysis applies in each dialog turn.

claims.claim: The final 嘅 ge3 in 我做會計嘅 and 人工OK嘅 should not be analyzed as occupation morphology or as the attributive marker merely from orthography.
claims.boundary: The g-family particle analysis is externally supported, but the exact discourse and syntactic analysis of each source item remains open.

claims.claim: 幾 in 幾辛苦㗎 is a degree adverb modifying a scalar or stative predicate, approximately ‘quite/fairly’ in this use.
claims.boundary: Exclude interrogative 幾, numeral 幾, and unsupported ellipsis from automatic identification of this degree use.

claims.claim: 做咩工 and 做會計 are occupational question/predicate attestations, but this packet does not establish a dedicated occupational construction or the argument structure of 做.
claims.boundary: Requires broader direct grammar and corpus evidence before identity or parser work.

claims.claim: 喺 + workplace + 返工 is at minimum compatible with a locative phrase plus work predicate analysis; the source does not license a new workplace-locative construction.
claims.boundary: No parser or construction change follows from this source alone.

claims.claim: 一萬 through 十萬 should remain compositionally analyzed rather than added as ten opaque whole-form lexical entries.
claims.boundary: This does not decide every runtime token boundary for complex money and salary expressions.

claims.claim: The lesson's long-versus-short vowel material is pronunciation evidence only; Cantonese vowel contrasts may involve both duration and quality, and each pair requires item-level verification.
claims.boundary: Do not generalize a pure-duration rule from /aː/–/ɐ/ to every vowel pair.

claims.claim: Glossika source glosses for 打工, 見工, and 出糧 require lexical review before learner-facing reuse.
claims.boundary: The source values remain immutable; this ledger does not assert corrected replacement glosses.

disposition.nextEvidence: Use the follow-up candidate ledger for bounded corpus research or role-neutral panel design only where external evidence remains inconclusive.
